text: Let O be an oracle. If there exists a keyed hash family with collision-resistance error εcr relative to O (Definition 3.21), then there exists a succinct vector commitment scheme with perfect completeness, hiding error ηvc (λ, N ) ≤ 2−λ , and position binding error f βvc (λ, N, s, q, t) ≤ εfcr (λ, q, t + poly(λ, s, log N ))
